designDecisionsAndRationale: Reuse WorkStore decisions/reservation as the sole durable causality and attempt-fence boundary so identity, replay and version checks remain shared.
Observe pending requests throughout the owned run, including requests from another CLI process, because an in-memory signal alone cannot deliver them.
Require proven worker stop and exact cancelled session persistence; transport acceptance, lease expiry and missing heartbeat alone cannot release the fence.
Route pending cancellation through exact acknowledgment before generic reconciliation or once-only replacement.
intentionalTradeoffs: Use bounded polling and waits within the existing run lifetime; keep uncertain outcomes fenced for explicit reconciliation.
Keep one coupled implementation plan with ordered internal gates because shared store, runner and worker changes need serial ownership.
